pages.en:
Memorandum on Foo Thai Keng (傅大慶).

Foo Thai Keng(傅大慶) alias Boon Tat Keng(文達慶)
alias Voo Tat Ming(符達明) alias Vung Tat Qon(文達寬)
alias Veng Dah Ching(文達慶) was arrested with Joseph
Ducroux alias Serge Lefranc on June 1, 1931 by the Sing
apore Police. He subsequently appeared before the Sing
apore Court on a charge of propagating communism and
on this charge was sentenced to six months imprison-
ment and ordered to be deported to China. He was sent
to Shanghai at his own request and was arrested by the
Soong-Wu Military Authorities on November 3, 1931, as
he disembarked from the s.s."President Cleveland" on
which he was travelling as a third-class passenger.

Other than information received from Singapore to
the effect that Foo and Serge Lefranc are associated,
the Shanghai Municipal Police are not in possession of
any further evidence that would implicate the former in
the Noulens' case, since none of the documents seized
in this case mention Foo's name.

However, from evidence in possession of the Sing-
apore Police, it would appear that the Communist Move-
ment in Malaya was under the direction of Foo Thai Keng
(        ) from the time he first arrived at Singapore
in November 1928 until his arrest in June 1931.
pages.zh:
关于 Foo Thai Keng (傅大慶) 的备忘录。

Foo Thai Keng (傅大慶)，别名 Boon Tat Keng (文達慶)，别名 Voo Tat Ming (符達明)，别名 Vung Tat Qon (文達寬)，别名 Veng Dah Ching (文達慶)，于1931年6月1日与新加坡警方逮捕的 Joseph Ducroux（别名 Serge Lefranc）一同被捕。他随后在新加坡法庭以传播共产主义罪名出庭，并因此罪被判处六个月监禁，并被勒令驱逐至中国。他应其本人要求被送往上海，并于1931年11月3日当他作为三等乘客从“克利夫兰总统号”（s.s. "President Cleveland"）轮船下船时，被宋吴军事当局（Soong-Wu Military Authorities）逮捕。

除了从新加坡方面获悉 Foo 与 Serge Lefranc 有关联这一信息外，上海公共租界工部局警务处并未掌握任何其他能将前者牵涉进 Noulens 案件的证据，因为在此案中查获的文件均未提及 Foo 的名字。

然而，根据新加坡警方掌握的证据，似乎从1928年11月 Foo Thai Keng (        ) 首次抵达新加坡起，直至1931年6月他被捕为止，马来亚的共产主义运动一直是在他的指导下进行的。

pages.en:
The following documents seized in connection with
enquiries made in the Noulens' case are purported to
have emanated from Serge Lefranc at Singapore:-

1. Document No.1 D.    Letter dated 'Singapore 27.3.31.'
                       partly in French and partly in
                       code, refers to the arrival of a
                       certain person from Shanghai for
                       information work. One 'Mr.Jack'
                       is mentioned.

2. Document No.2 D.    Cablegram dated '17.V.Nr.9'.
                       "Connections well established. Have"
                       "you any further instructions and "
                       "money concerning budget Malaya Pen"
                       "insula C.P.,Trade Unions,Youth."
                       "Please write us fully".

3. Document No.3 D.    Document in English appealing for
                       help as they(?) are without help
                       and are communicating with Quoc -
                       an Annamite Communist. Also refers
                       to the new address as "New Mansion,
                       Oxley Rise." (Possibly refers to
                       Serge Lefranc who resided, prior to
                       his arrest, at a boarding house at
                       Oxley Rise, Singapore)

4. Document No.5 D.    Letter in French dated 'Singapore
                       4.5.31.' mentioning the addresses:-
                       "Serglefran,Singapore" and "Post
                       Box Number 307 Singapore". The
                       signature of the sender is unde-
                       cipherable.

The originals of 1, 3, and 4 above have been lent to
the French Police.
pages.zh:
以下是在调查 Noulens 案件过程中查获的文件，据称源自新加坡的 Serge Lefranc：-

1. 文件编号 1 D.    日期为“新加坡 1931年3月27日”的信件，
                       部分用法语书写，部分使用密码，
                       提及某个人从上海抵达以从事情报工作。
                       信中提到了一个“Jack 先生”。

2. 文件编号 2 D.    日期为“17.V.Nr.9”的电报。
                       “联系已妥善建立。是否有”
                       “关于马来亚半岛共产党、工会、青年团”
                       “预算的进一步指示和资金。”
                       “请详复”。

3. 文件编号 3 D.    一份英文文件，呼吁援助，因为他们(?)缺乏帮助，
                       并与 Quoc - 一位安南（越南）共产党人进行联络。
                       还提到了新地址为“New Mansion, Oxley Rise”。
                       （可能指 Serge Lefranc，他在被捕前居住于
                       新加坡 Oxley Rise 的一家寄宿公寓）

4. 文件编号 5 D.    日期为“新加坡 1931年5月4日”的法文信件，
                       提及地址：“Serglefran, Singapore” 和
                       “新加坡 307号邮政信箱”。发件人签名无法辨认。

上述第1、3和4号文件的原件已借给法国警方。

pages.en:
EXTRACT FROM DAILY INTELLIGENCE REPORT DATED 4/11/31.

Communist Propaganda - Arrest of Associate of Lefranc

Acting on information conveyed to them by the Municipal
Police to the effect that one Foo Tat-min (符達民) alias Fu
Ta Kien (傅大慶), a Chinese associate of the III International
agent Lefranc, was coming to Shanghai by the s.s. "President
Cleveland", the Public Safety Bureau arrested the individual in
question when the ship arrived here on November 3.

Chinese Authorities state that the prisoner has been
identified as a native of Kiangsi who assisted Borodin when the
latter was associated with the Kuomintang in 1926. They add
that Foo studied abroad in both Russia and France.
pages.zh:
摘自1931年11月4日的每日情报报告。

共产主义宣传 - 逮捕 Lefranc 的同伙

根据工部局警务处向其传达的情报，即第三国际代理人 Lefranc 的中国同伙 Foo Tat-min (符達民)，别名 Fu Ta Kien (傅大慶)，将乘坐“克利夫兰总统号”轮船前来上海，公共安全局在该船于11月3日抵达此地时逮捕了该人。

中国当局称，该囚犯被确认为江西人，曾在1926年鲍罗廷（Borodin）与国民党合作期间协助过鲍罗廷。他们补充说，Foo 曾在俄罗斯和法国留学。

COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of Letter from Chief Procurator of Kiangsu 2nd Branch
High Court.
April 6, 1932.
No. 114

S.M.P. Headquarters,
Shanghai.

Sirs,

I am in receipt of an instructional order No.4661
from the Procurator's Office of the Supreme Court stating
as follows :-

"In connection with Houlens case, a joint-offender
named Poo Da Ching (傅大慶), who was arrested together
with a Frenchman in the Straits Settlement on 1.6.31, was
subsequently brought before the Singapore Court on a charge
of propagating communism for which he was sentenced to six
months' imprisonment. At the expiry of his term of impri-
sonment, he left for Shanghai, when the Shanghai Municipal
Police was informed of his arrival by the Singapore Police
authorities. His movements were since kept under observation
and the Garrison Headquarters of Nanking and Shanghai were
informed by the S. M. P. which resulted in his arrest on
5.11.31, for Communistic activities. It is believed that
the S. M. P. are aware of his activities in Singapore or in
possession of details surrounding his arrest or proceedings
of the trial. We are also anxious to know whether or not
this person, Poo Da Ching (傅大慶), is one of the prisoners
arrested in connection with the Houlens case. Will you
please make careful enquiries and obtain proof, if any, from
the said Police Force and transmit it to us for investigation"

As requested, any assistance you may be able to
render in this connection will be much appreciated.

Wang Tseng Nan
Chief Procurator
Kiangsu 2nd Branch High Court.

致：
上海工部局警务处总部，

先生们：

本院收到最高法院检察署第4661号指令，内容如下：-

“关于 Houlens 案件，一名名为 Poo Da Ching (傅大慶) 的共同犯罪人，于1931年6月1日在海峡殖民地与一名法国人一同被捕，随后在新加坡法庭以传播共产主义罪名受审，并被判处六个月监禁。刑满后，他前往上海，新加坡警方当局已将其抵达情况通知上海公共租界工部局警务处。此后其行踪一直受到监视，工部局警务处并通知了南京和上海卫戍司令部，导致其于1931年11月5日因共产主义活动被捕。相信工部局警务处知晓其在新加坡的活动，或掌握其被捕或审判程序的详细情况。我们也急于知道此人 Poo Da Ching (傅大慶) 是否属于因 Houlens 案件被捕的囚犯之一。请仔细查询，并从上述警队获取任何证据，转交本院以便调查”

如蒙协助，不胜感激。

王曾楠
首席检察官
江苏高等法院第二分院

Straits Settlements Police Political Intelligence
Journal, Singapore, 15th November, 1931.

Page 66.

(4) Shanghai. Foo Thai Keng (傅大慶) alias Boon Tat Keng
(文世慶) (page 31) who was arrested in Singapore with
Joseph Ducroux alias Serge Lefranc on 1.6.31 and who was
subsequently sentenced to six months R.I. and finally
banished to China, was sent at his own request to
Shanghai where he arrived on 5.11.31. He was arrested
on arrival in Shanghai by the Public Safety Bureau and has
been handed over to the Chinese Authorities. He has
been identified as Moscow-trained student and as an
associate of Borodin in 1926. This proves, if further
proof were needed, that since November 1928 when Foo Thai
Keng first arrived in Singapore, up to June 1931, the
Communist movement in Malaya was under the direction of a
Moscow trained mind.

annex to file.

Reg

November 3 1.

My dear Steptoe,

With reference to the information conveyed
by you to this office to the effect that one Foo Fat
King(符大名 ) alias Fu Ta Kien(傅達慶), a Chinese
associate of the III International agent Lefranc,
was coming to Shanghai by the s.s. "President Cleveland",
I have to state that the Public Safety Bureau (Chinese
Territory Police) arrested the individual in question
when the ship arrived here.

Foo has been identified as a native of Kiangsi
who assisted Borodin when the latter was associated
with the Kuomintang in 1926. The Chinese Authorities
also state that Foo studied abroad in both Russia and
France.

Yours sincerely,

H. N. Steptoe, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General.

Sent out
3/XI 31. N. O.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
C. & S. D. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2866
3 / 11 21

November 3 2.

My dear Sarly,

Acting on information conveyed to them
by the Municipal Police to the effect that one
Foo Fat Ming(符大名 ) alias Fu Ta Kiem(傅達慶),
a Chinese associate of the III International agent
Lefranc, was coming to Shanghai by the s.s."President
Cleveland", the Public Safety Bureau arrested the
individual in question when the ship arrived here.
The Chinese Authorities state that the prisoner has
been identified as a native of Kiangsi who assisted
Borodin when the latter was associated with the
Kuomintang in 1926. They add that Foo studied abroad
in both Russia and France.

Yours sincerely,

R. Sarly, Esq.,
French Police Headquarters.

Sent out
3/XI-21. N.G?

1931年11月3日 2时。

亲爱的 Sarly：

根据工部局警务处向其传达的情报，即第三国际代理人 Lefranc 的中国同伙 Foo Fat Ming (符大名)，别名 Fu Ta Kiem (傅達慶)，将乘坐“克利夫兰总统号”轮船前来上海，公共安全局在该船抵达此地时逮捕了该人。中国当局称，该囚犯被确认为江西人，曾在1926年鲍罗廷与国民党合作期间协助过鲍罗廷。他们补充说，Foo 曾在俄罗斯和法国留学。

此致
敬礼

R. Sarly 先生，

S.I. Station,
Date 3 Nov 1931）

Subject (in full) arrest of noted communist

Made by Supt Tan Shao Liang Forwarded by Henry Robertson, C.S.I.

Foo Tat Ming 傅達明 alias Fu Ta Kien 傅大堅 a noted
communist was arrested at 6 a.m. November 3 by Detectives
of the Soong Wu Military Headquarters on a launch in the
Whangpoo River when he disembarked from the s.s. Cleveland
on which he travelled as a 3rd class passenger on deportation
from Singapore. The prisoner is a native of Kiangsi, a returned
student from France and Russia. He also worked with Brodin
in the Nationalist Government in 1926 and is well known
to many of the Nanking officials.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.

Officer i/c S.B.

事由（全称）逮捕著名共产党人

由谭绍良警司呈报 经亨利·罗伯逊（Henry Robertson），C.S.I. 转呈

傅達明（Foo Tat Ming），又名傅大堅（Fu Ta Kien），系一名著名共产党人，于11月3日上午6时，在黄浦江的一艘汽艇上被宋武军事总部（音译）的侦探逮捕，当时他正从“克利夫兰”号轮船（s.s. Cleveland）下船。他是作为三等乘客乘坐该轮从新加坡被驱逐出境的。该犯籍贯江西，是留法及留俄归国学生。他还曾于1926年在国民政府中与布罗丁（Brodin）共事，为许多南京官员所熟知。

谭绍良
警司。

特别股主管警官

Date Sept. 2nd., 1931）

Subject (in full) Letter from H.B.M.Consulate - General Re: Fu Tai Keng (傅大慶)

Made by D.I.Ross. Forwarded by D.B.Ross

With reference to the letter of August 5,1931,from H.B.M.
Consulate-General on the subject of one Fu Tai Keng (傅大慶),
who was arrested together with Le Franc at Singapore, I have to
report that the Nanking Government has no definite charge against
him,although they know that he is a Communist and is known to have
participated in the Canton uprising in December 1927.
The Chinese authorities have no objection to taking him over
provided he can be extradited from Singapore.
The original photo is attached herewith for return to H.B.M.
Consulate.

D.B.Ross
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

事由（全称）英国总领事馆来函——关于傅大慶（傅大慶）

由罗斯督察（D.I. Ross）拟稿 经 D.B. 罗斯转呈

关于英国总领事馆1931年8月5日来函，提及傅大慶（傅大慶）一事，该人与勒弗朗（Le Franc）一同在新加坡被捕，兹报告如下：南京政府对他并无明确指控，尽管他们知道他是共产党人，且已知其参与了1927年12月的广州起义。
只要能从新加坡引渡此人，中国当局不反对接收。
原照片附后，请退还英国总领事馆。

D.B. 罗斯
督察。

Officer of the Director,
Criminal Intelligence Department,
Straits Settlements.
Singapore, July 23, 1931.

Special Branch C.B.11/31/3

Dear Steptoe,
I enclose a photograph of a Hupeh
Chinese who, you will remember, was arrested with
Ducroux alias Lefranc and was sentenced to six
months' R.I. with him.
He is known to us under the name
of Foo Tai Kheng (        )and knows English.
He appears to be about 30 years, though he gives his
age 25 years. He is very short sighted and wears horn-rimmed
rimmed spectacles. He has been in Malaya for the
last three years and was the head of the local
Communist Organisations.
It is now stated that he is wanted by
the Chinese Government. If so, could you please let
me know when convenient.
Yours sincerely,

H.N. Steptoe, Esq.,
H.B.M's Vice-Consul,
Shanghai.

特别股 C.B.11/31/3

亲爱的斯蒂普托：

现附上一名湖北籍中国人的照片，你应记得，他与杜克鲁（Ducroux），又名勒弗朗（Lefranc）一同被捕，并与他一同被判六个月苦役。
我们知其名为 Foo Tai Kheng（        ），他懂英语。
他看起来约30岁，尽管他自称25岁。他近视严重，佩戴角质边框眼镜。过去三年他在马来亚，是当地共产党组织的负责人。
现称中国政府正在通缉他。若是如此，能否请在方便时告知我。
此致

敬礼，

H.N. 斯蒂普托 先生，
英国副领事，
上海。
